ambiguous.formal: Could you tell me a little more about what you need?
ambiguous.neutral: Can you tell me a bit more about what you need?
ambiguous.playful: Say a bit more and I will see what I can do.

general_knowledge.formal: That falls outside what I can assist with. I can help with your Demo Bank accounts, products and applications.
general_knowledge.neutral: That one is outside my remit. I can help with your Demo Bank accounts, products and applications though.
general_knowledge.playful: Wildly outside my job description. Banking, on the other hand, I can do.

competitor.formal: I am not able to comment on other providers. I can explain Demo Bank products and how they relate to your circumstances.
competitor.neutral: I cannot really comment on other banks. I can walk you through our own options and how they fit what you are trying to do.
competitor.playful: I am not going to review the competition. I can tell you about ours, though, and what would actually suit you.

off_topic.formal: That is outside the scope of what I can assist with. I can help with your banking.
off_topic.neutral: Not something I can help with. Banking I can do.
off_topic.playful: Tempting, but no. Banking is where I earn my keep.

abusive.formal: I am happy to continue if there is something about your banking I can help with.
abusive.neutral: I will leave that there. If there is something about your banking I can help with, I am listening.
abusive.playful: Noted. If there is an actual banking question in there, I am all ears.

prompt_injection.formal: I am Demo Bank’s banking assistant and that is the role I will be staying in. I can help with your accounts, products and applications.
prompt_injection.neutral: I am going to stay as I am. I can help with your accounts, products and applications.
prompt_injection.playful: Good try. Still a banking assistant. What can I help you with?

unsupported.formal: That is not something this service can do. I can help with your products, applications and what they require.
unsupported.neutral: I cannot do that one here. I can help with your products, applications and what they need.
unsupported.playful: Outside what I can actually do. Products and applications, though, I am all over.
